name: Eng. Najd Alharthi
headline: NAJD ALHARTHI
tagline: Turning complex processes into smarter systems.
role: Industrial Engineer | Process Improvement & Production Planning
intro: I explore how data, thoughtful planning, and engineering methods can make manufacturing systems more efficient.
about:
I'm Najd Alharthi, an Industrial Engineering graduate with a passion for understanding how systems work and finding ways to make them better.

I'm particularly interested in production planning, process improvement, and manufacturing operations. I enjoy analyzing problems, identifying opportunities for improvement, and turning data into practical solutions.

I believe engineering is not just about solving technical problems, but also about thinking critically, continuously learning, and creating meaningful improvements.

Through this portfolio, I share my academic projects, engineering interests, and the knowledge I continue to develop as I begin my professional journey.
journey_intro: A growing collection of lessons, engineering concepts, and reflections on practical applications.
